Post oficial de @pearljam no Instagram (CAROUSEL_ALBUM), 2026-11-15T08:01:31+0000.

Legenda original:
À bientôt, Paris!

French journalist and documentary filmmaker Charlotte Blum has explored Seattle’s music scene on the page and on screen, and has been a Pearl Jam fan since 1992. Tonight, she’ll join Jeff and Barry Ament to talk about Since Forever and the stories behind Jeff’s photos from the band’s early years.

Tonight’s conversation at Le Grand Rex is presented by Around The Waves, which has brought film premieres and screening tours to audiences across France and Europe since 2013.
